notes.title: Big update, story mode is complete.
notes.content:
Finally, I released a new patch 1.11, which includes three new levels and three new enemies, including a final boss. Enjoy the game and save the 'wolf souls' world.
You can look forward to an icy world among rocks, ice, and piles of snow.

notes.title: 2.7.2023 - Balancing and small bugs
notes.content:
Fixed - Punches are still active after NPCs death
Balancing - Death achievement changed to 1-10-25-50 (originaly 1-10-50-100)
New feature - Rogue like changed with Hardcore difficulity (Roguelike mode is in development with randomized location)
New Feature - Aiming with "lightning bolt" ability, you can hit enemies below and above you.
Balancing - shield duration, mana regeneration
Balancing - Stamina regeneration, sprint and roll takes less stamina
